In this video, Chloe Genter, a conservation technician at the Library of Congress, shares an inside look at one of the most fascinating institutions in the world.
Chloe explains what the Library of Congress actually is (and why it’s much more than just books), how it serves both the U.S. Congress and the public, and what makes it the world’s largest library. The Library preserves the creative record of the United States while providing access to materials from around the globe, both onsite and online.
